_notice: SYNTHETIC - FICTIONAL ORGANIZATION FOR THE WATER CHALLENGE - NOT WATERAID DATA

organization.federation: Member of Water Care International, a fictional alliance that runs country programs; Water Care Canada raises and grants funds to them
organization.vision: Communities that can count on water, toilets and hygiene services long after any project ends.
organization.mission: Make safe water, sanitation and hygiene permanent: services that last, systems that hold, and women and girls leading the decisions.

values.Durability: We judge success by what still works in ten years.
values.Local leadership: District governments and local partners lead; we strengthen.
values.Candour: We report what failed as clearly as what worked.
values.Thrift: Every dollar and every staff hour goes where it changes most.

organization.ambition: 1.5 million people with lasting water, sanitation and hygiene services in Water Care focus districts by 2033.

goals.name: Services that last
goals.description: District water, sanitation and hygiene systems that keep working: local government and utilities, health facilities, and climate-resilient water sources.
priorities: Health-facility WASH in every focus district
Climate-risk assessment in every project design
Maintenance financing agreed before anything is built

goals.name: Women and girls decide
goals.description: Gender-transformative programming: women in leadership roles on water committees and in utilities; menstrual health in schools and clinics.
priorities: Women hold at least 40% of water-committee leadership roles

goals.name: Canada invests
goals.description: More and better Canadian money for lasting WASH: institutional fundraising, public engagement, and policy work with the Government of Canada.
priorities: Foundations from 14% to 20% of income by FY2029-30

lenses.Gender-transformative: Every project must show how it shifts decision-making power toward women and girls.
lenses.Climate-resilient: Every project must show how services will survive floods, droughts and rising demand.

countries.name: Malawi
countries.note: 3 focus districts; health-facility WASH, menstrual health in schools

countries.name: Mozambique
countries.note: 2 focus districts in Inhambane Province; climate-resilient rural water after cyclone damage

countries.name: Ethiopia
countries.note: 2 focus woredas; drought-resilient water supply, small-town utilities

countries.name: Nepal
countries.note: 2 focus municipalities; spring-source protection, WASH in birthing centres

countries.name: Zambia
countries.note: Federation program; Water Care Canada co-funds only, no Canadian-led projects

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.note: Federation program; climate-vulnerable coastal areas; co-funding only

themes.label: WASH in healthcare facilities
themes.description: Water, sanitation, hygiene, cleaning and waste services in clinics and birthing centres; maternal and newborn health.

themes.label: Climate-resilient water services
themes.description: Climate-risk assessment, drought/flood-resilient sources, water-security planning, adaptation finance.

themes.label: Gender-transformative WASH
themes.description: Women's leadership, menstrual health, safety and dignity in sanitation.

themes.label: District WASH systems strengthening
themes.description: Local government, utilities, service-delivery models, monitoring, O&M financing.

themes.label: WASH in schools
themes.description: Water, toilets, handwashing and menstrual-health facilities in schools.

themes.label: Hygiene behaviour change
themes.description: Handwashing and hygiene promotion linked to services.

themes.label: Sanitation services
themes.description: Household and public sanitation services and faecal sludge management.

themes.label: Canadian policy and advocacy
themes.description: Public policy dialogue and research in Canada (permitted charitable activity).

themes.label: Canadian public engagement
themes.description: Global citizenship education and public engagement in Canada.

exclusions.label: Acute humanitarian / emergency first response
exclusions.rule: Water Care does not run emergency response; recovery-phase work only, through federation programs.

exclusions.label: Domestic Canadian programs (including First Nations drinking water)
exclusions.rule: No programs in Canada. Canadian activity is limited to engagement and policy work.

exclusions.label: Capital-only infrastructure without an O&M plan
exclusions.rule: Water Care will not build what no one is funded to maintain.

exclusions.label: Grants or scholarships to individuals
exclusions.rule: Not part of the delivery model.

exclusions.label: Stand-alone academic research
exclusions.rule: Only as an implementing partner on applied research.

finance.audited: Yes; clean audit opinions FY2023-24 to FY2025-26

excluded: Companies with active WASH-related human-rights litigation
gift_acceptance.process: Review-category gifts go to the CEO with a one-page risk note; decision within 10 business days.

qualified_donee.label: Qualified donee
qualified_donee.match_rule: Private and public foundations in Canada can generally grant only to qualified donees. Passes this gate.

cra_designation.label: CRA designation
cra_designation.match_rule: Some funders exclude public/private foundations as applicants. Water Care is not a foundation.

business_number.label: Charitable registration #
business_number.match_rule: Placeholder only. Never treat as real.

years_registered.label: Years registered
years_registered.match_rule: Passes minimum operating-history rules up to 22 years.

hq.label: Head office
hq.match_rule: Passes Ontario- and GTA-restricted funders ONLY when the funder allows international beneficiaries.

staff_provinces.label: Provinces with staff
staff_provinces.value: Ontario (22 FTE), British Columbia (2 FTE remote)
staff_provinces.match_rule: No Quebec presence. Fails funders requiring a Quebec office.

delivery_model.label: Delivery model
delivery_model.value: International programs delivered through Water Care International country programs and local partners, via grant agreements with accountability measures (qualifying disbursements) or direct-and-control arrangements
delivery_model.match_rule: Fails funders that fund only local in-country CSOs directly. Passes funders that fund Canadian charities working internationally.

regions.label: Regions
regions.value: Southern Africa, East Africa, South Asia
regions.match_rule: Fails region-restricted funders outside these (e.g., West Africa only, Latin America).

themes_excluded.label: Will not do
themes_excluded.value: Emergency first response; domestic Canadian programs; capital-only works; grants to individuals; stand-alone research

populations.label: Populations
populations.value: Women and girls; People with disabilities; Rural and peri-urban low-income communities; Healthcare workers and patients (maternal and newborn care); School-age children

languages.label: Application languages
languages.value: English: full capacity. French: summaries only (1 staff member)
languages.match_rule: Fails funders requiring full French applications.

women_led.label: Women-led organization
women_led.value: CEO is a woman; 7 of 12 directors are women; Board Chair is a man
women_led.match_rule: AMBIGUOUS: passes 'woman CEO' or 'majority-women board' definitions; fails 'woman Board Chair' or '75%+ women' definitions. Flag for human review.

policies.label: Policies in place
policies.value: Safeguarding; gender equality; anti-fraud and corruption; sanctions/anti-terrorism screening; environmental and social safeguards; privacy; whistleblower

grant_min_viable.label: Minimum viable grant
grant_min_viable.match_rule: Below this, decline unless a strategic relationship justifies it.

grant_sweet_spot.label: Grant sweet spot
grant_sweet_spot.match_rule: Best yield per hour of effort.

max_new_restricted.label: Max new restricted funding per year
max_new_restricted.match_rule: Program absorptive capacity; larger awards need a consortium.

match_capacity.label: Cash match capacity
match_capacity.value: Up to 20% of project value from unrestricted funds
match_capacity.match_rule: Fails 1:1 match requirements unless a co-funder is secured.

indirect_rate.label: Standard indirect cost rate
indirect_rate.match_rule: Funders capping indirect costs below 10% reduce net value (soft penalty, not a gate).

reporting.label: Reporting capacity
reporting.value: Quarterly or semi-annual narrative + financial is standard; monthly reporting is high burden

gift_excluded.label: Gift acceptance: excluded sources
gift_excluded.value: Tobacco; weapons; gambling; companies with active WASH-related human-rights litigation

gift_review.label: Gift acceptance: CEO review required
gift_review.value: Bottled water and beverage companies; extractives (mining, oil and gas); agro-chemicals

us_status.label: US tax status
us_status.value: None (no US 501(c)(3) affiliate; no equivalency determination on file)
us_status.match_rule: US private foundations need an equivalency determination or expenditure responsibility. Flag as uncertain.

gates.name: Legal eligibility
gates.test: Funder accepts registered Canadian charities / qualified donees (EP-01, EP-02, EP-03, EP-35).

gates.name: Beneficiary geography
gates.test: International work allowed AND at least one Water Care country or region eligible (EP-13 to EP-16).

gates.name: Thematic eligibility
gates.test: WASH or a core-adjacent theme (health, climate, gender) is fundable; not an excluded theme (EP-17 to EP-19).

gates.name: Organizational restrictions
gates.test: Revenue caps, Indigenous-led, women-led, grassroots, provincial presence, language (EP-08, EP-09, EP-22 to EP-24).

gates.name: Gift acceptance
gates.test: Source is not excluded; review-category sources route to REVIEW (EP-33, EP-34).

gates.name: Access
gates.test: Open call, LOI, rolling, or invitation with a credible relationship path.

gates.name: Timeline feasibility
gates.test: Days to deadline at or above the minimum preparation days for the application type, with hours available.

gates.name: Financial terms
gates.test: Match requirement within 20% capacity, or a co-funder identified (EP-29).

criteria.name: Strategic alignment
criteria.anchors: 5 = core theme is the funder's stated priority; 3 = secondary theme or WASH as an eligible activity under health/climate/gender; 1 = loose link.

criteria.name: Geographic alignment
criteria.anchors: 5 = priority country named; 4 = region-open including a priority country; 3 = global; 2 = secondary country only.

criteria.name: Economic yield
criteria.anchors: Expected value per fundraising hour (Capacity_Model, includes LOI follow-on effort): 5 = above $3,000; 4 = $1,500-3,000; 3 = $750-1,500; 2 = $300-750; 1 = below $300.

criteria.name: Relationship strength
criteria.anchors: 5 = active funder; 4 = warm (board or staff connection with consent); 3 = lapsed in good standing; 2 = cold; 1 = lapsed with issues.

criteria.name: Win signals
criteria.anchors: 5 = funds peer international WASH charities; 3 = funds international development generally; 1 = no international giving history.

criteria.name: Timeline & burden
criteria.anchors: 5 = comfortable timeline, light reporting; 3 = tight or quarterly reporting; 1 = monthly reporting or very tight.

criteria.name: Strategic value
criteria.anchors: 5 = multi-year, unrestricted or policy access; 3 = standard restricted; 1 = restricted and one-off.

decisions.PURSUE: Eligible, fit score at or above 3.5, and capacity available this quarter.
decisions.PURSUE-QUEUE: Eligible with strong fit, but this quarter's capacity is used up; schedule for next window.
decisions.CULTIVATE: Not applicable now (invitation-only, relationship needs repair, no open call) but worth building toward.
decisions.REVIEW: A human decision is required: gift acceptance, ambiguous eligibility, or conflicting/unverified facts.
decisions.MONITOR: Eligible but moderate fit (2.8-3.49) or no confirmed deadline; recheck next cycle.
decisions.DECLINE: Fails a hard gate or fit score below 2.8.
